label: Smart outfits
description: Business and smart casual looks with tailored or polished everyday garments.
notes: Complete workwear and smart casual outfits. Casual owns relaxed daily clothes; formal owns evening and ceremonial dress. Garments define presentation rather than wearer identity; excludes occupational equipment, accessories, and uniforms with insignia. Garments never imply descent or body type. Cultural garments are available in any region. Use subject-appropriate pronouns. Picks require writer compatibility with the setting and activity. Palette roles colour garments as one coordinated look. Coverage describes garment extent. Historical fabrics use muted or earthy schemes.
